N.capCoordinateRule: Canonical cap shader Object.Y must evaluate as -cornerLocalX; canonicalZ remains cornerLocalZ. A native per-port coordinate carrier/transform or mathematically equivalent shader is allowed; untransformed corner Object.Y is not equivalent.

canonicalPorts.continuityLaw: Exact finite six-point cap profile and outward cap normals. Exposed boundary geometry, actual custom face-corner normals and material/albedo behavior match approved middle under these transforms. Evaluate intermediate transverse points and all edge endpoints, not only vertices, labels or AABBs.

boundedCollars.why: These collars lie within exact approved constant endpoint bands and are disjoint. Full .08 middle bands overlap near the inner corner below the shoulder; copying them as disjoint exposed skins would inherit weak turn construction.
boundedCollars.required: Retain canonical endpoint geometry/normal/albedo field continuously through each collar; then rebuild a clean turn. No hidden duplicate intersection surface is required. Implementation remains editor-owned.

canonicalPorts.endClosure: Each disconnected true port has a planar six-vertex cap with canonical native cut-stone field in its own transverse/Z coordinates. Connected internal caps must never become visible seams. Non-port finite exterior sides close natively and remain readable; no extruded opaque floor.

lightAndShader.rig: Exact canonical middle finite-area rig, neutral world0, no shadow receivers, no cast shadows. See actual recorded light positions/powers/sizes/rotations in canonical-middle-field.json. Same rig/camera/color grade for all single and assembly views.
lightAndShader.boundaryShader: Reuse exact canonical body/cap behavior including point albedo field, roughness/specular/coat/emission and RGB-only grade. Map N cap coordinates as above. Interior color/detail may improve coherently, without boundary field changes.
lightAndShader.broadResidualPolicy: Finite area lighting can create broad differences between centered independent singles and translated native multi-object scenes. Preserve/report these separately from alpha undercoverage and local join defects; never claim whole-image pixel parity or grant a numerical-only seam waiver.
